title: Option Deposit Payments on Design Studio Selections Files
content:
The buyer pays the option deposit due on a Design Studio Selections file. A payment of the option deposit due is posted against the line number of the most recently added option line on the file that is not a studio fee line (a design consultation fee, package fee, card convenience fee or returned payment fee line). Each payment raises the option deposits Calloway holds on the file and is shown on the design ledger with its Calloway receipt number.

**Conditions on the amount**

The option deposit due is fixed only after every change order number carried by an option line on the file has its change order entry on the design ledger. The option deposit due is not fixed until every selection appointment held beyond the package's included appointments has its consultation fee line on the file. The option deposit due is worked out only once every error-correcting change order on the file carries its builder goodwill credit memo.

## Buyer payment tool: `pay_option_deposit_3846be30`

**Capability.** One call posts one option deposit payment from the buyer, dated today, with the payment method chosen and the option line whose deposit it settles, prints a new Calloway receipt number for it and raises the option deposits held on the file by the amount paid.

**Invocation.** This tool belongs to the buyer: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `selection_id` | The reference number of the buyer's Design Studio Selections file, as given to the buyer by the representative | Id |
| `option_line_ref` | The line number of the option line whose deposit this payment settles, exactly as printed on the selection sheet and read to the buyer by the representative | Verbatim, copied character for character |
| `payment_method` | How the buyer pays | `card` — debit or credit card; `ach` — electronic transfer from the buyer's bank account; `check` — paper check; `wire` — bank wire transfer |
| `amount` | The amount paid | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `design_event_id` (the reference number of the payment entry), `payment_reference` (the Calloway receipt number printed for this payment, RCPT-DS- followed by five digits), `option_line_ref` (as passed), `payment_method` (as passed), `amount` (the amount paid, USD with 2 decimals), `option_deposit_held` (the option deposits held on the file in USD, including this payment) and `status`, which reads "posted" when the payment was recorded.
